❤️ The hardest goodbye is the one where you know you have to let Bappa go…

Ganpati Bappa Morya! 🙏🐘✨

Anant Chaturdashi is not just a day of visarjan… it is an emotion that every Bappa devotee understands. ❤️

For days, Bappa filled our homes, streets, hearts, and lives with happiness, devotion, positivity, music, celebration, and unforgettable memories. 🌺🥁✨

And then comes this moment…

The moment when we carry Bappa for the final journey.
The moment when the dhol beats feel different.
The moment when thousands of voices chant “Ganpati Bappa Morya” with tears in their eyes. 🥹❤️

We know Bappa is going back to His divine abode, but a part of our heart goes with Him.

Bappa, thank you for coming into our lives, for blessing our families, for giving us strength when we needed it, and for filling every moment with hope and positivity. 🙏✨

May you take away all our worries, obstacles, negativity, and pain with you… and leave behind only happiness, prosperity, peace, success, and countless blessings. ❤️🌺

GANPATI BAPPA MORYA! ❤️
